description: Searches homes and properties in Switzerland – to rent or buy, also by feel (ruhig, sonnig, lebendig/belebt, grün, zentral, familienfreundlich; calme, ensoleillé, animé; tranquillo, vivace) (Wohnung mieten/kaufen, Haus kaufen, WG-Zimmer, Studio; appartement à louer/acheter, maison; appartamento in affitto/in vendita; flat, apartment, house). Covers current listings on Heimster and on Swiss agency websites, with walking distance to supermarket, childcare (Kita, crèche), school, park, stop and train station; quiet locations (road/rail noise); sun score; and the door-to-door public-transport commute to the person's workplace (workplace + max_commute_min). Ask where they work when the commute matters. Filter by place, type, rooms, price and area; sort by newest or price.

category.description: rent (default), buy, shared_flat (WG room) or sublet.

green.description: Only green, family-friendly surroundings: parks & playgrounds within 500 m (grün, im Grünen, Natur, Spielplatz; verdure; verde).

language.description: Language of titles, descriptions and links (default de). Use the user's language.

lively.description: Only lively locations: many restaurants & cafés within 500 m on foot (belebt, lebendig, urban, Ausgang; animé; vivace). Use for «vivid area», «lots of restaurants», «where things happen».

max_childcare_m.description: Max distance (m) to childcare (Kita) or kindergarten.

max_commute_min.description: Max door-to-door minutes by public transport to the workplace (default 30).

max_stop_m.description: Max distance (m) to a bus/tram stop.

max_supermarket_m.description: Max walking distance (m) to a supermarket.

max_train_station_m.description: Max distance (m) to a train station.

min_sun_score.description: Minimum Heimster sun score (0–100, direct sun on the building/flat).

place.description: Municipality, postal code or canton in Switzerland, e.g. «Winterthur», «8004», «ZH».

price_max.description: CHF; per month for rent, total for buy.

price_min.description: CHF; per month for rent, total for buy.

quiet.description: Only quiet locations: road/rail noise by day below 55 dB at the facade.

workplace.description: Where the user works or studies (address or place) – for the commute filter.

name: search_listings
title: Search homes on Heimster
